purpose.en: Build the glutes and strengthen hip extension.

text.zh: 四足跪姿，腿伸直向后上方抬
text.en: On hands and knees, lift your straight leg back and up
Keep your lower back from sagging and let the hip do the work.

text.zh: 顶端停一秒，再慢慢放下
text.en: Pause for a second at the top, then lower slowly.

commonErrors.zh: 抬太高导致腰过度后仰
commonErrors.en: Lifting too high and overarching the lower back.

cautions.zh: 腰部不适时减小幅度，仍痛就停止
cautions.en: Reduce the range if your lower back feels uncomfortable, and stop if it still hurts.
